Automated Anatomical Labeling atlases

Source: R/data.R
aal_atlases.Rd

Accessors for the AAL1, AAL2 and AAL3 atlas families.

Usage

aal1_cortical()

aal1_subcortical()

aal1_cerebellum()

aal2_cortical()

aal2_subcortical()

aal2_cerebellum()

aal3_cortical()

aal3_subcortical()

aal3_cerebellum()

aal()

aal2()

Details

Each atlas is provided as three anatomical components:

  • cortical: cortical atlas

  • subcortical: subcortical atlas

  • cerebellum: cerebellar atlas

Functions

  • aal1_cortical(): AAL1 cortical atlas containing 82 cortical regions.

  • aal1_subcortical(): AAL1 subcortical atlas containing 8 regions.

  • aal1_cerebellum(): AAL1 cerebellar atlas containing 26 regions.

  • aal2_cortical(): AAL2 cortical atlas containing 86 cortical regions, including the AAL2 orbitofrontal parcellation.

  • aal2_subcortical(): AAL2 subcortical atlas containing 8 regions.

  • aal2_cerebellum(): AAL2 cerebellar atlas containing 26 regions.

  • aal3_cortical(): AAL3 cortical atlas containing 90 cortical regions, including anterior cingulate subdivisions.

  • aal3_subcortical(): AAL3 subcortical atlas containing 50 regions, including thalamic subdivisions.

  • aal3_cerebellum(): AAL3 cerebellar atlas containing 26 regions.

  • aal(): Backwards-compatible alias for the original AAL cortical atlas.

  • aal2(): Backwards-compatible alias for the AAL2 cortical atlas.

Atlas composition

  • AAL1: 82 cortical + 8 subcortical + 26 cerebellar = 116 regions.

  • AAL2: 86 cortical + 8 subcortical + 26 cerebellar = 120 regions.

  • AAL3: 90 cortical + 50 subcortical + 26 cerebellar = 166 regions.

References

Rolls, E. T., Huang, C. C., Lin, C. P., Feng, J., & Joliot, M. (2020). Automated anatomical labelling atlas 3. NeuroImage, 206. PubMed

Rolls, E. T., Joliot, M., & Tzourio-Mazoyer, N. (2015). Implementation of a new parcellation of the orbitofrontal cortex in the automated anatomical labeling atlas. NeuroImage, 122, 1-5. PubMed

Tzourio-Mazoyer, N., Landeau, B., Papathanassiou, D., Crivello, F., Étard, O., Delcroix, N., Mazoyer, B., & Joliot, M. (2002). Automated Anatomical Labeling of Activations in SPM Using a Macroscopic Anatomical Parcellation of the MNI MRI Single-Subject Brain. NeuroImage, 15, 273-289. PubMed
